verification_limits: Complete outflow logs and boundary timestamps match NodeReal and NOWNodes. Only one NOWNodes individual receipt/transaction was available; all 17 were verified on NodeReal.

First-funding states, transactions, successful receipts and complete candidate-block traces were verified on NodeReal. NOWNodes historical state and all five cited funding transactions were unavailable; bloXroute also returned no cited funding transactions. No independent two-provider funding-history verification is claimed.

Earliest-activity search uses balance>0 OR nonce>0 under ordinary EOA history. Historically transient contracts that receive and lose BNB without persistent nonce/state are not exhaustively excluded by a full-chain trace scan.
A common first funder is an association heuristic. It cannot prove common control; absent or different funders cannot establish distinct operators.
